items.notes: AUDITED 2026-08-30, do not print unverified. 91 citations but only 7 domains; heaviest are IDFA (dairy trade association) and a content farm. Repeats two debunked legends as fact: Catherine de Medici 1533, and soft serve invented 1939 by Dairy Queen. The Tang dynasty term is garbled. Usable as a starting map, not as a source.
